We evaluate our method on both human and automated benchmarks, measuring the content‑independence, quality, and utility of STYLEDISTANCE embeddings. By creating near‑exact paraphrases with controlled stylistic variations, we produce positive and negative examples across 40 distinct style features.

A core component of our proposed STYLEDISTANCE approach is a LLM that generates a synthetic dataset with controlled content and style. The dataset is composed of pairs of sentences which are paraphrases of each other (i.e. their content is similar) but differ in style.
